purpose: refuses a branch, subject, or title the policy forbids

--input.description: prints the facts as JSON instead of judging them

--facts.description: judges the facts document in <file>, and gathers nothing; for testing a rule against a fixture

--rules.description: lists each rule the policy judges by: its name, its pattern, and where the pattern is set, as a table; it reads no facts and no forge

--json.description: with --rules, one JSON object a line: rule, pattern, from, and engine; from is kit.yml where the policy: map sets the rule, else default, and engine is the engine that judges, patterns or opa

--jq.description: the same JSON, formatted by jq for a person
